title: Friction Scout: Daily Digest + Field Requests (2026-04-12)
summary: Rapid synthesis of customer friction signals collected during Apr 10-12. Focus: three high-frequency themes (latency unpredictability, token-cost opacity, private deploy onboarding). Includes quick experiments, micro-proposals, and recommended owners for next 2 sprints.
raw_customer_quotes: We see big spikes mid-day, sometimes latency triples for certain prompt lengths.
Your token billing is hard to reconcile with our internal cost dashboards.
Private deployment guide was missing a step for our HSM config; we spent two days troubleshooting.
When a canary fails we need an automatic fallback to an older model version — manual rollback is risky.
notes:
Context and how this digest was made:
- Sources: frontline CS calls (4), SRE incident summaries (2), Solutions Eng demo sessions (3), internal Slack thread #cs-friction (ongoing).
- Sampling window: 2026-04-10 through 2026-04-12. Priority to issues that: recur across customers, block go-live, or incur measurable cost/ops overhead.

Observed signal clusters (compact):
1) Latency unpredictability (high volume):
   - Pattern: customers using streaming + longer context (5k-10k) report intermittent tail latency spikes during multi-tenant bursts.
   - Impact: UX timeouts, customer throttling logic misfires, rollback to synchronous short requests.
   - Evidence: three customers in fintech + one internal staging workload observed 2–4x P95 increases during backup cycles.

2) Token billing opacity & embedding unit confusion (medium volume):
   - Pattern: teams mix embeddings + gen calls in pipelines and can't map tokens to cost buckets; some think streaming reduces billed tokens.
   - Impact: surprise invoices, delayed budgeting decisions for Dedicated capacity.
   - Evidence: billing disputes raised with CS; one customer paused Dedicated commit while we provided cost breakdown.

3) Private deployment onboarding friction (low-medium volume, high severity):
   - Pattern: documentation gaps for KMS/HSM integration and network egress firewall rules. On-prem installers assume a default cert flow that enterprise infra blocks.
   - Impact: multi-day stalled deployment, security team escalations.
   - Evidence: two recent installs required Solutions Eng escalation and a temporary script patch.

Micro-proposals and quick experiments (fast, low-effort first):
- EPIC A: 'Tailwatch' ruleset (owner: eng-sre)
  - Deploy lightweight monitors to alert on sudden P95/P99 divergence versus rolling baseline (first pass: host-level metric + model variant tag).
  - Quick experiment: enable on two high-volume tenants for 7 days, compare incident rate.
- EPIC B: Billing reconciler snippet (owner: product-hosted-api + finance)
  - Provide a one-page explained view mapping request types (stream vs non-stream), embeddings, batching and caching to expected token patterns.
  - Deliverable: markdown + ready-to-run sample curl calls that customers can paste into their budgeting spreadsheet.
- EPIC C: Private deploy preflight checklist + HSM troubleshooting doc (owner: private-deployments + solutions-eng)
  - One-page preflight with exact firewall ports, cert thumbprint steps, and HSM provider quirks.
  - Deliverable: a shell script that runs preflight checks and outputs a single PASS/FAIL with actionable hints.

Triage matrix (one-liner):
- Critical-High (1): Private deploys blocked by security/HSM issues -> immediate SE deep-dive, patch doc, and short-term support hours.
- High (2): Latency tails during bursts -> SRE probe + Tailwatch monitor, consider model-variant fallback policy.
- Medium (3): Billing clarity -> customer-facing reconciler + updated pricing FAQ.
- Low (4): UX/console microcopy that confuses streaming -> doc update next sprint.

Sample short-term owner assignments (weeks 0–2):
- eng-sre: implement Tailwatch metric and alert rule prototype (owner: Jorge Ramirez).
- private-deployments: write HSM preflight and automation script (owner: Maya Thompson).
- product-hosted-api + finance: produce billing reconciler and sample sheets (owner: Ethan Liu).
- customer-success: communicate interim mitigation steps and collect follow-up logs (owner: Priya Das).

Notes-to-self / unresolved questions:
- Should fallback on canary failure be opt-in or opt-out? Need product/legal input for SLA implications. (Issue: JIRA-CS-2147)
- Are we certain streaming does not reduce billed tokens when prefix caching is used? Cross-check with billing team.
- For Tailwatch, what is the signal-to-noise threshold to avoid alert fatigue? Start conservative (50% divergence) and tune.

Next steps (immediate):
1) Sync triage with SRE and private-deployments tomorrow (15m).
2) Draft billing reconciler markdown and share to small pilot group (2 customers) by EOD+3.
3) Run preflight script on last two failed installs and capture telemetry.

Quick metrics snapshot (as-reported by customers):
- Number of customers reporting latency spikes: 4
- Average additional hours spent per private install due to HSM issues: 28h
- Billing confusion cases opened last 30 days: 6

If you want to pull a clumped timeline for stakeholder updates, I can convert this into a 1-pager and produce a timeline for the next two sprints.
